subject: Fix schedule-wakeup leak: dedup + reap detached node sleepers (no more accumulation)
description: lib/schedule-wakeup.js spawns a detached `node -e setTimeout` sleeper per scheduled wakeup/task and never reaps/dedups them — 187 stale node processes accumulated over a day (see the prevention note). FIX: (1) maintain a registry (e.g. .graph/scheduled-wakeups.json) of {key → pid, fireAt}; (2) on re-schedule of the same logical wakeup key, kill the prior sleeper PID before spawning the new one (dedup); (3) reap on fire (the child should exit after firing) and on cancel; (4) on daemon boot, sweep + kill orphaned ORCH_SCHEDULED_TASK node processes (or sleepers whose registry entry is stale). Add a unit/integration test that re-scheduling the same key N times leaves exactly ONE live sleeper, not N. Keep it cross-platform (Windows + posix).
